d: Yemen's Houthi rebels have reportedly struck a skyscraper in Saudi Arabia's capital, Riyadh, injuring at least 11 people. The attack targeted the 80-storey Public Investment Fund (PIF) Tower in the city's King Abdullah Financial District, which houses the headquarters of Saudi Arabia's sovereign wealth fund. Saudi authorities blamed the Houthis for the attack, marking the second strike on the landmark building in less than a week. Those injured include Indian, Nepali, Egyptian and Saudi nationals.
